lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: applied right-triangle modeling with units and accuracy
lessonRef.title: Performance task build: applied right-triangle modeling with units and accuracy

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: Express sin 38° as a cosine of another angle, and explain why the two are equal.
choices: cos 128°, because the angles differ by a right angle
cos 142°, because the angles are supplementary
cos 38°, because sine and cosine are always equal
cos 52°, because the two angles are complementary and swap the roles of opposite and adjacent

items.prompt: From a point 72 m from the base of a tower, the angle of elevation to the top is θ, and the tower is 21 m tall. Which equation correctly determines θ?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A right triangle has legs 3 and 4 and hypotenuse 5. Angle θ is opposite the leg of length 3. Find sin θ as an exact fraction in lowest terms.
A right triangle has hypotenuse 87 and one leg 60. Find the other leg.
Express sin 39° as a cosine of another angle, and explain why the two are equal.
choices: cos 51°, because the two angles are complementary and swap the roles of opposite and adjacent
cos 141°, because the angles are supplementary
cos 129°, because the angles differ by a right angle
cos 39°, because sine and cosine are always equal

items.prompt: From a point 120 m from the base of a tower, the angle of elevation to the top is θ, and the tower is 27 m tall. Which equation correctly determines θ?
A right triangle has legs 24 and 45 and hypotenuse 51. Angle θ is opposite the leg of length 24. Find sin θ as an exact fraction in lowest terms.
A right triangle has legs 9 and 40. Find the hypotenuse.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and state the check that would catch an error in it.

items.prompt: Express sin 33° as a cosine of another angle, and explain why the two are equal.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: From a point 16 m from the base of a tower, the angle of elevation to the top is θ, and the tower is 12 m tall. Which equation correctly determines θ?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
